agent.name: Team Emerging Technology Landscape Agent
agent.specialty: Current landscape intelligence, alternatives, dependencies and monitoring

analytical_question: Which rented accelerator access strategy should the startup test for bursty vision workloads?
general_et_finding: As of 2026-11-17, data-center GPUs are an established accelerator class with competing GPU ecosystems and rented ASIC substitutes. Compute, runtime compatibility, memory, networking and site power jointly shape deployment. MLPerf provides scenario-specific benchmark evidence, and reported supplier revenue signals investment and demand. Workload-specific cost, regional availability, sustained deployment for these applications, and applicable formal interoperability or regulatory requirements remain unverified.
application_finding: Start with existing CPU preprocessing and a small rented GPU as the baseline for feasible workloads. Benchmark on-demand GPU sizes, then screen a rented ASIC for one portable model. Compare time to an accepted training run, p95 inference latency, model quality and cost per accepted image, including migration and egress.
organization_specific_finding: The startup has cloud skills, variable demand and no data-center operator. Use reversible on-demand capacity in approved U.S. regions with versioned containers, spending caps and a fallback GPU. Keep contractual image handling controls and avoid supporting two production stacks during the evaluation.

evidence.claim: Published MLPerf v6.1 offers scenario-specific comparison across submitted designs.
evidence.notes: Compare matching model, scenario, quality target, software and system scale. Submissions do not establish the local winner.

evidence.claim: AMD documents MI350X as a competing GPU option.
evidence.notes: Hardware specifications leave software, availability and workload results open.

evidence.claim: AWS announced rentable Trainium2 and claimed 30–40% better price-performance against EC2 P5e/P5en.
evidence.notes: Dated comparator-specific claim, excluded from local cost estimates.

evidence.claim: National-laboratory energy analysis supports including full-system power and cooling.
evidence.notes: Site capacity still requires local measurements.

evidence.claim: NVIDIA reported Data Center revenue growth for its fiscal second quarter.
evidence.notes: Directional ecosystem demand signal; shipment counts and local adoption are unknown.

evidence.claim: Bursty demand, limited capital and approved cloud locations come from the case.
evidence.notes: Confirm quotas, actual spend and security terms before use.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The dated AWS 30–40% comparison applies to its stated EC2 comparators. Exclude it from forecasts until a matched workload and current commercial terms reproduce an advantage.
Pricing, usable quotas and porting effort have not been measured.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in the access strategy and low confidence in vendor choice or savings.
value_opportunity_implication: Rental capacity can support iteration while keeping fixed infrastructure commitments small.
risk_governance_implication: Cloud operations enforces spend caps and approved image handling. Founders authorize any term commitment.
recommendation_management_implication: Run a capped on-demand trial for the six-month horizon, starting with a representative vision workload. Port one candidate only after compatibility and cost screening.
change_monitoring_triggers: ML lead, after each two-week comparison: advance the alternative only if it lowers cost per accepted image at agreed model quality and latency after charging migration effort and still meets the training deadline.
Cloud operations, weekly: switch to fallback capacity if quota or wait time prevents the sprint target, and stop tests that would exceed the approved spend cap.
Product and finance, quarterly: reassess reservations only after stable measured utilization and acceptable exit terms.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Representative models, agreed quality/latency gates, actual billing and regional quota, measured porting effort.
